text:
hana cho: quick heads-up - customer reported seeing alerts from another org in Console after rapid org hops. replicated locally.

evan roth: which service stack? routing/affinity or prefetch?

hana cho: prefetch + routing-affinity rollout (canary). repro: orgX -> orgY -> orgX within ~300ms. sometimes left-nav cards show orgY items while header shows orgX.

meera kapoor: likely race: we stash headers into prefetch jobs at enqueue time. when session rotates, worker still uses old x-org header. leads to UI mixing and wrong quota attribution.

evan roth: ugly. two risks: data leakage and billing misattribution. we need a short-term guard + long-term fix.

hana cho: short-term: on job start, resolve session id to current org and compare to job.header.x-org. if mismatch, re-fetch with current org and emit telemetry prefetched_org_mismatch. fail-open but prefer correct org.

meera kapoor: agreed. long-term: stop serializing tenant headers into job payloads. store session reference only and resolve at runtime. that needs migration for existing queued jobs.

evan roth: migration plan: sweep queue for jobs older than 24h, re-enqueue with resolved session refs. For new jobs, validate before enqueue that header==resolved(org) or refuse enqueue.

hana cho: add tests: unit test for worker resolve, integration quick-switch loop 200x as gate, and a billing reconciliation job to catch any earlier misattributions.

ops-bot: watch memory for worker changes during canary deploy (previous worker change caused +60MB).

meera kapoor: I'll draft a small feature-flagged patch `worker_resolve_org` defaulted ON for canary. will add telemetry counter `queue_org_mismatch` and tag traces for auditing.

evan roth: include rollback steps and a smoke e2e. also add a console UX note: if we detect a mismatch we should show a subtle banner "Refreshing data to ensure correct view" while re-fetching so customer doesn't see mixed rows.

hana cho: good customer-facing idea. PR please and ping #release-war-room when ready.

deploy-bot: Deployed branch fix/queue-resolve-org to canary-2 at 2025-02-15T11:05:00Z :white_check_mark:

meera kapoor: after canary run (1000 quick switches) mismatch rate dropped to 0. Billing team notified and will run a reconciliation for the last 48h. Closing thread unless new reports. :tada:
